page.overview:
Who is Amber Duffman?

Amber Duffman is the estranged daughter of Duffman. She only gets mentioned by Duffman in "To Surveil with Love" before she makes her first appearance in "From Beer to Paternity."

After Duffman gave free Duff stuff to everyone at Moe's Tavern, he says he has a date with his estranged daughter. He also says she dropped out of college, but can't say why because it's too sad.

She opened a marijuana dispensary called "Amber's Cannabis & Cannabis Accessories," where Duffman becomes "Puffman," the mascot for the dispensary.
